items.note: Treatment train for one system → ProcessDiagram: serpentine boxes with glyphs

items.note: Documentation package → DocList: document code tiles

items.note: Questions engineers ask → FAQ: numbered question cards, the open one widens

items.note: Links to related pages → RelatedLinks: cards hanging from one pipe, ghost numbers

items.note: Closing call to action → Closing: framed headline, proof box from the page's facts

items.note: Case study → CaseStudy: fact boxes beside one large outcome figure

items.title: L form
items.note: Request a proposal form → EnquiryForm: numbered data sheet in a drawing frame

items.title: M standards
items.note: Standards we design to → StandardsGrid: numbered standard cards joined by thin lines

items.title: N readout
items.note: One measured figure → Readout: instrument display with limit tag and tick scale

items.title: O prose
items.note: Explanatory text without a wall of text → Prose: pulled-out lead, narrow column, margin notes

items.title: P band
items.note: One statement between two sections → Band: one large sentence in a framed panel with a faint technical motif

items.title: Q grid
items.note: A set of choices that is not a card grid → LinkGrid: staggered numbered choices joined by one routed line

items.title: R table
items.note: Comparing water grades without a wall of text → CompareTable: numbered column heads in a drawing frame; on phones, one column at a time behind tabs

items.title: S hub hero
items.note: Header of a hub page that lists one area → Hero on hub and company pages: numbered index of the pages inside the area, joined by a routed line

items.title: T footer
items.note: Footer as the border of a drawing sheet → Footer: zone-referenced sheet border, numbered link columns, title block

items.title: U home hero
items.note: Home page first screen, water at the limit → Hero on the home page: large headline beside a fine-line drawing of a distribution loop

items.title: V nav
items.note: Main navigation and the "On this page" bar → NavBar and SectionNav: numbered tabs, the section you are reading marked, page progress

items.title: W keyfacts
items.note: Key facts under a page header → KeyFacts: numbered cells on a measurement strip, value with unit and its source

items.title: X page rhythm
items.note: One long system page, mostly navy with light sections between → Page ground: navy blueprint page with light drawing sheets for reading (.aq-sheet); 41-concept-page-sheets gave the sheet frame and title block

items.title: Y router
items.note: A situation router instead of a 4-column table → Router: situations on the left, one route through water, system and first step

items.title: Z versus
items.note: Hot or ambient WFI, two routes compared → Versus: two routes across a spine of factors, a verdict for each
